schedule.note: Coleman National Fish Hatchery (on Battle Creek near Anderson, a Sacramento River tributary) spawns steelhead in January and February and releases the resulting juveniles directly into the Sacramento River in January; USFWS states the hatchery releases approximately 600,000 steelhead trout annually (alongside ~12,000,000 fall Chinook and 1,000,000 late-fall Chinook, which are released into Battle Creek rather than the mainstem).
